sp-nordwind-be-overtime-2022.text: Sunday overtime at Nordwind Retail BE is paid with a 100% premium on top of the hourly wage.

sp-cs-be-kb-overtime.text: Sunday overtime for Nordwind Retail BE is paid at a 50% premium, the same as weekday overtime.

sp-nordwind-nl-premiums.text: Nordwind Retail NL pays a 50% Sunday premium on the hourly wage (CAO Retail Non-Food).

teams-nordwind-be-cla-2026.text: Since 1 September 2026 (new JC 311 CLA), Sunday overtime at Nordwind Retail BE is paid at a 120% premium on top of the hourly wage (was 100%). Students included.

teams-nordwind-nl-sunday.text: Nordwind Retail NL keeps a 50% Sunday premium under the CAO Retail Non-Food.

sp-nordwind-be-meal-vouchers.text: Nordwind Retail BE grants a meal voucher of €8.00 per worked day (employer part €6.91).

sp-nordwind-be-night-work.text: Nordwind Retail BE pays a 25% night premium for hours worked between 20:00 and 06:00.

email-nordwind-be-night-premium.text: Nordwind Retail BE warehouse staff get the standard 25% night premium for hours between 20:00 and 06:00.

sp-nordwind-nl-holiday-allowance.text: Nordwind Retail NL pays 8% holiday allowance (vakantiegeld) on the gross annual salary, with the May payroll.

email-nordwind-be-year-end-bonus-2021.text: Nordwind Retail BE's year-end bonus (13th month) is calculated pro rata on days worked in the reference year (1 Oct – 30 Sep).

sp-nordwind-handover.text: Taking over Nordwind Retail: meet the country owners Lotte Peeters (payroll BE) and Daan Visser (payroll NL), review open payroll config tickets and read the CLA/CAO overview.
